name: three-fidelity
description: Three.js rendering fidelity suite: screen-space techniques, path tracers and Blender references.

scripts.build: pnpm build:fidelity-kit && tsc -b && pnpm build:three && pnpm -r --if-present --filter "@three-fidelity/*" build
scripts.performance:run: pnpm build:fidelity-kit && fidelity-kit benchmark ${PERFORMANCE_MACHINE:+--machine "$PERFORMANCE_MACHINE"} --registry registry.json --collection default --out performance-results
scripts.performance:serve: pnpm build:fidelity-kit && fidelity-kit serve fidelity-results --performance-root performance-results --registry registry.json
scripts.performance:metallic: pnpm build:fidelity-kit && fidelity-kit benchmark ${PERFORMANCE_MACHINE:+--machine "$PERFORMANCE_MACHINE"} --registry registry.json --collection metallic --out performance-results --renderer-root packages/playground/dist
scripts.performance:process: pnpm build:fidelity-kit && fidelity-kit process fidelity-results --performance-root performance-results
scripts.performance:convergence: pnpm build:fidelity-kit && fidelity-kit benchmark ${PERFORMANCE_MACHINE:+--machine "$PERFORMANCE_MACHINE"} --registry registry.json --collection convergence --out performance-results --renderer-root packages/playground/dist
scripts.render: pnpm build:fidelity-kit && fidelity-kit render --registry registry.json --out fidelity-results
scripts.performance:representative: pnpm build:fidelity-kit && fidelity-kit benchmark --registry registry.json --collection representative --out performance-results --renderer-root render-site
